title: RecoveryProfile
description: Stage 9 operational entity: ONE documented recovery target of ONE recovery kind for ONE subject asset. The reserved 'fallback-system' concept is ABSORBED here (fallback-system.schema.json is kept only as an absorbed marker; there is exactly one RecoveryProfile entity, never two). A RecoveryProfile is NOT a graph node: it cites Stage 7 graph edges only as soft references. There is deliberately NO 'RETIRED' state: administrative retirement uses REJECTED with an explicit reason. No fabricated data.

asset_type.description: Subject asset type: exactly the Stage 8 asset types (Stage 7 graph node types).

asset_id.description: Subject asset record id in the canonical collection.

failure_scenario_id.description: Optional Stage 8 FailureScenario giving the failure context.

recovery_kind.description: Exactly five frozen kinds; the kind decides which target collections are valid.

target_id.description: Exactly one target reference; multiple targets require multiple profiles.

expected_recovery_time.description: Descriptive free text; never a computed score.

recovery_radius.description: Descriptive free text; never a computed score.

recovery_cost.description: Descriptive free text; never a computed score.

edge_citations.description: Soft references to Stage 7 graph edges: never required, never hard-resolved, never auto-creating edges.

status.description: Frozen lifecycle; no RETIRED state by design.

review_reason.description: Explicit reason: required for VERIFIED, REJECTED (also administrative retirement) and supersession.

history.description: Audited lifecycle history (snapshots, never silent edits).
